name: Kisnil Kagri
source:
A wandering swordswoman who is under the command of Gilsh Loos as a third-class guest general in his Dragon Maw Knight Platoon at the start of the story. She oversees the excavation work of the ruins Avaro is working in when monsters attack and she is forced to evacuate the workers to fight them off together with Avaro.

Extremely serious and with a strong sense of duty, she prioritises the welfare of civilians above all else and will disobey orders to save civilians in peril. She is also capable of keeping her professional and private life separate and will engage Avaro in conversation even when circumstances dictate they must take opposing sides.

Completely incapable of everyday tasks outside of combat and wielding a sword, she also has no inhibitions with respect to her appearance when in her own quarters.

[Spoiler] Kisnil was forced into exile from her homeland after her lord was killed during a rebellion whilst she was away saving civilians from raiding bandits. Although her lord gave his blessing for her to leave his bodyguard to save the people, she nonetheless feels guilty and believes she was directly responsible for her lord's death. His final order was for Kisnil to save as many civilians as she could, which she tries to uphold in memory of him. [/Spoiler]
